definitions.ask: Should the local-install profile also turn off local ThinLTO for a faster build?
definitions.why: bob runs interactively all day; ~15 s per install is not worth a ~25% slower binary

choices.label: Pulled-commit reinstalls take ~73 s; installed bob runs ~3-5% slower than a release build
Pulled-commit reinstalls take ~58 s; installed bob runs ~25% slower on a heavy DQL query
